messages:
alex.k: heads up — saw an edge case in the 'Add scoped credential' modal when a tenant has both per-route quotas and routing policies.
tasha: ah yeah, what behavior are you seeing?
alex.k: when you pick a subset of routes + a routing policy, the UI shows the effective quota as the tenant default, not the route-min. user can create credential that actually violates route min quota.
ben_p: thats bad. backend currently applies quota checks only at request-time, not on creation. iirc the create-token API only validates scope format, not cross-referencing routing_policy or route quotas.
sophie: can you paste the payload you used? might help reproduce.
alex.k: payload is simple:
```
POST /v1/tokens
{
  "name": "svc-data-ingest",
  "scopes": ["routes:write:data-ingest"],
  "routing_policy_id": "rp-42",
  "quota_units": 1000
}
```
alex.k: rp-42 has route affinity to route A with min_quota 2000.
ben_p: so create succeeds and later requests are throttled. we should prevent creation or surface a warning.
matt_r: two options:
- validate on create against the union of route minima (fail creation)
- allow create but show a big warning and auto-escalate to request higher quota
alex.k: product prefers warning+canary so existing flows dont break. but for enterprise contracts we might need strict deny.
tasha: we need to handle both: deny for tenants with "strict_quota_enforcement" flag, otherwise warn. also add telemetry to count how often creds get throttled.
sophie: telemetry event names? proposal: `rbac.scoped_credential.create_attempt` with attrs {tenant_id, routing_policy_id, scopes, quota_units, validated_min_quota, enforcement_mode}
ben_p: agree. and emit `rbac.scoped_credential.throttled_event` when request hits runtime throttle because of credential mismatch.
alex.k: backend change required: create-token v2 should accept `validate_against_routes=true|false` and return `effective_quota` and `warnings`.
ben_p: will add server-side validation + a fast cache of route minima to avoid expensive joins. cache keyed by routing_policy_id.
matt_r: for console UX: show an inline "Effective limits" card with list of affected routes, their min_quota, and which one is binding. if enforcement flag on tenant -> red error state.
tasha: also show a short explainer: "Selecting these routes + policy means credential will be bound to these minimum quotas — creating with lower quota will cause runtime throttles unless tenant enables override." keep copy short.
sophie: rollout plan: ship API v2 + telemetry, then console feature-flagged rollout (10% -> 25% -> all). add an audit log entry for admin when a credential is created that has warnings.
ben_p: technical caveat: service accounts created via infra APIs (non-console) need same validation. will expose header `X-Bypass-Quota-Validation: true` for emergency automation and require admin token + audit.
alex.k: can we sample 1% of the warning cases and attach a repro payload + tenant id to private S3 for debugging? Tasha: ok? (PII check)
tasha: fine if scrubbed and tenant-id-only. add sampling config in telemetry service.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rbac-token-service v2 -> staging at 2024-11-07T18:15:00Z :rocket:
matt_r: follow-ups: matt to mock the "Effective limits" card, ben to land API + cache, sophie to add telemetry events, alex to write console copy + warning copy. can we sync tomorrow 11am?
alex.k: yes, 11am works. thanks all :thumbsup:
